events.title: Northstar Advisory Services / Harbor City / Duplicate transaction posting

workflow.owner_organisation: Northstar Advisory Services → Fictional Enterprise Operations

narrative.background_detail: Northstar Advisory Services uses NexusOne to support a fictional operational workflow for Client Group Beta. The scenario in this record is fully simulated for an internship assessment and does not describe a real person, client, account, system, or event.
narrative.issue_detail: A transaction was posted twice after a retry was processed as a new request. The duplicate was detected during daily reconciliation and reversed.

narrative.impact_detail: The fictional event affected 26 synthetic records and required approximately 17 hours of remediation. No real client, employee, account, or production environment is represented.
narrative.opportunity: Add idempotency checks and a duplicate-warning control before submission.
